description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

Once per day, fuse mutation-wise with your Feral Bond for a minute: every mutation either of you carries applies to both.

For the duration, you and your Feral Bond count as a single body for the purpose of your mutations: every Gift and every Tithe either of you carries applies to both of you simultaneously, Slot for Slot. When the minute ends, the fusion releases cleanly — no extra Strain, no Bloom roll, just two bodies that spent a minute agreeing they were one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Both the mutation/Slot economy and the cross-actor sharing are independently unbuilt. The Strain/Bloom-Table/mutation-Slot economy has no SpecialResource or other Foundry-schema representation anywhere in the corpus (confirmed via grep -rli '"strain"' site/data/cards/classes/, no hits, and grep -rl '"key": "SpecialResource"' site/data/cards/, one unrelated hit in fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json). This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
